title: Comfy Collab Artifact v1
description: A ComfyUI workflow produced an artifact (image, video, audio, model, text). Carries the artifact type, content URI, and minimal metadata. Linked to the parent prompt via prompt_id. Consumed by the room notebook + creator-canvas-primary to surface the artifact in the room.

room_id.description: Room manifest identifier the artifact was produced in.

session_id.description: P7 room session id the artifact belongs to.

prompt_id.description: The prompt that produced this artifact. Matches a comfy.collab.prompt.v1.prompt_id.

app_slug.description: Pinokio app slug that produced the artifact (e.g. comfyui-desktop, ace-step, wan).

uri.description: Resolvable URI for the artifact content. Typically minio://bucket/key or pinokio://api/<slug>/outputs/<file>.

thumbnail_uri.description: Optional thumbnail URI for the artifact (smaller, faster to load).

metadata.description: Optional artifact metadata (dimensions, size_bytes, seed, model, duration_sec, etc.). Free-form.

produced_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the artifact was produced.
